headline: Lufthansa First Class Award Space Disappears for Partner Programs; Frontier Adds First Transfer Partner with Bonus
reasoning: Both articles present highly relevant and actionable information for points and miles enthusiasts. The Lufthansa news, while speculative, addresses a significant shift in premium award availability, directly impacting high-value redemptions. The Frontier news offers a new, albeit niche, opportunity for earning and redeeming miles, with a timely transfer bonus. Both sources are highly credible in the travel points and miles space.
summary: Lufthansa has reportedly ceased releasing First Class award space to partner frequent flyer programs since June 1, 2026, a move speculated to be permanent. Separately, Frontier Airlines has announced Rove as its first transfer partner, offering a 25% bonus on transfers until July 31.

source_articles.title: Lufthansa First Class Awards With Partner Miles: I Assume It’s The End
source_articles.excerpt: As of June 1, 2026, Lufthansa completely stopped releasing first class award space to partner frequent flyer programs. source_articles.title: Frontier's first transfer partner: Rove adds Frontier Miles with 25% transfer bonus
source_articles.excerpt: You can now transfer Rove miles to Frontier, with a limited-time 25% transfer bonus.
